mentions.name: Tavi
mentions.description: A deep people search agent that lives in Slack. It is built as an agent-first product where the agent is the whole product, not just a component, and is designed to solve a specific problem out of the box. The team used it to find their founding engineer.
mentions.problem: Deep people search — finding the right people, such as sourcing a founding engineer, out of the box.
mentions.source_excerpt: Tavi is a deep people search agent that lives in Slack. We used it to find our founding engineer and our first customers are a mix startups, recruiters and VCs.

evidence.value: Tavi is a deep people search agent that lives in Slack. We used it to find our founding engineer and our first customers are a mix startups, recruiters and VCs.
